scoring_justification: Headline quantities (elastic constants, anisotropy) are produced by DFT computations; recomputing from raw energy‑strain data in the verifier is infeasible, so we compare agent‑reported values against paper‑reported values and necessary structural trends (softening, hardening, cross‑consistency).

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported elastic constants at zero pressure (C11=246.99, C12=131.19, C44=19.77 GPa) and anisotropy indices in Table III.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the exact numbers published in the paper.

outputs.description: Pressure-dependent elastic constants at 0 K. Checked against paper-reported values within tolerance and softness trends.
Anisotropy indices at selected pressures. Checked against paper-reported values within tolerance.
Temperature dependence of C44. Checked for the structural property that C44 at 1000 K and 2000 K must be greater than or equal to C44 at 0 K at each pressure.

Elastic moduli along rhombohedral paths. Checked for cross-consistency: the arithmetic mean of C_RH1 and C_RH2 must agree with the independently computed C44 (from elastic_constants_pressure.csv) within a hidden relative tolerance.

output_contract.notes: All scored artifacts must be produced from genuine DFT calculations using the public BCC Nb structure, PBE functional, and a PAW pseudopotential. The hidden verifier will compare the required quantities against paper-reported values or structural relations, without revealing tolerances or gold values.
